text:
jamie: Updating SOC2 tenant-rehoming docs; need quick sign-off on phrasing + SDK snippet.

jamie: Draft: "On tenant rehoming requests Redwood streams tenant-scoped audit events as encrypted newline-delimited JSONL. Exports are stored encrypted and retained for up to 30 days in transit unless otherwise agreed in an SLA. Sensitive fields may be pseudonymized or redacted per customer configuration and in accordance with Redwood's data minimization procedures. For Private deployments, customers can elect to manage KMS keys."

naren: Legal: change to "unless otherwise agreed" and add how to request extended retention (support email + ticket); wording looks good with the pseudonymization clause.

taylor: Docs: include a minimal curl + Python streaming snippet and a 1-line JSONL example; link to streaming guide.

ashley: Eng: export format is newline-delimited JSON (JSONL). Ordering preserved per-partition only; include sequence_id and partition_id in the export to support resume and validation. Recommend Accept: application/jsonl header and backpressure handling.

docs-bot: PR #4021 opened with these changes; reviewers added.

jamie: Great, will merge once PR includes snippets, support link, and KMS sentence.

naren: Approved after support link added.

jamie: Merged. Thread closed.
